adversary.name: APT Active Directory Surveyor
adversary.description: A quiet, highly resilient Active Directory surveyor that maps domain trust, delegation, users, and certificates via native ADSI/LDAP queries with automated payload fallback.
adversary.execution_strategy: Executes localized PowerShell ADSI and LDAP queries natively with individual try/catch error traps, dynamically resolving the domain landscape and executing optional tools.
